svg.title: Control Rights Before Selling the Spread
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-parcel-to-retained-spread; chart type: process_flow; title: Control Rights Before Selling the Spread; subtitle: Five operating steps from a mapped parcel to collected operator revenue; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: This workflow serves telecom rights, billboard assignments, and industrial outdoor storage. First-deal planning remains 2–6 months. The scorecard counts earned spreads and fees, excluding institutional purchase principal and tenant gross billings.; caption: A mapped opportunity becomes inventory only after rights, consents, permitted use, and an executable exit are documented.; stages: label: Map eligible parcels; value: FCC ASR + DOT AADT; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Join FCC ASR records, state DOT annual average daily traffic layers, and assessor parcels in QGIS. Verify rooftop candidates separately because ASR is not a complete inventory of telecom installations.; label: Establish transferable control; value: Title + options + consents; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Review recorded instruments, lease amendments, assignment limits, mortgage priority, and access rights. Use diligence-contingent control documents and identify required lender subordination, nondisturbance, and attornment agreements.; label: Underwrite the actual spread; value: Cash-flow NPV + buyer bids; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Model escalators, termination, restoration, and collection risk in a spreadsheet. Test a 16×–22× telecom buyer multiple only as an illustrative sensitivity on buyer-accepted annual contractual rent; obtain written bids before relying on an exit value.; label: Clear site-specific execution risks; value: Permits + environmental + access; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Confirm sign spacing and digital operation permissions, telecom access and utility easements, or IOS heavy-axle use and stormwater obligations. Commission Phase I work before executing an IOS master lease.; label: Close and reconcile collections; value: Settlement ledger + yard billing; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match settlement statements to earned assignment or buyout spreads. For IOS, reconcile contracted tenant receipts, master rent, and directly allocated property obligations before measuring retained spread; link RFID access to the authorized tenant roster.

rect.title: label: Map eligible parcels; value: FCC ASR + DOT AADT; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Join FCC ASR records, state DOT annual average daily traffic layers, and assessor parcels in QGIS. Verify rooftop candidates separately because ASR is not a complete inventory of telecom installations.

text.title: Join FCC ASR records, state DOT annual average daily traffic layers, and assessor parcels in QGIS. Verify rooftop candidates separately because ASR is not a complete inventory of telecom installations.

rect.title: label: Establish transferable control; value: Title + options + consents; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Review recorded instruments, lease amendments, assignment limits, mortgage priority, and access rights. Use diligence-contingent control documents and identify required lender subordination, nondisturbance, and attornment agreements.

text.title: Review recorded instruments, lease amendments, assignment limits, mortgage priority, and access rights. Use diligence-contingent control documents and identify required lender subordination, nondisturbance, and attornment agreements.

rect.title: label: Underwrite the actual spread; value: Cash-flow NPV + buyer bids; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Model escalators, termination, restoration, and collection risk in a spreadsheet. Test a 16×–22× telecom buyer multiple only as an illustrative sensitivity on buyer-accepted annual contractual rent; obtain written bids before relying on an exit value.

text.title: Model escalators, termination, restoration, and collection risk in a spreadsheet. Test a 16×–22× telecom buyer multiple only as an illustrative sensitivity on buyer-accepted annual contractual rent; obtain written bids before relying on an exit value.

rect.title: label: Clear site-specific execution risks; value: Permits + environmental + access; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Confirm sign spacing and digital operation permissions, telecom access and utility easements, or IOS heavy-axle use and stormwater obligations. Commission Phase I work before executing an IOS master lease.

text.title: Confirm sign spacing and digital operation permissions, telecom access and utility easements, or IOS heavy-axle use and stormwater obligations. Commission Phase I work before executing an IOS master lease.

rect.title: label: Close and reconcile collections; value: Settlement ledger + yard billing; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match settlement statements to earned assignment or buyout spreads. For IOS, reconcile contracted tenant receipts, master rent, and directly allocated property obligations before measuring retained spread; link RFID access to the authorized tenant roster.

text.title: Match settlement statements to earned assignment or buyout spreads. For IOS, reconcile contracted tenant receipts, master rent, and directly allocated property obligations before measuring retained spread; link RFID access to the authorized tenant roster.

Assumptions: This workflow serves telecom rights, billboard assignments, and industrial outdoor storage. First-deal planning remains 2–6 months. The scorecard counts earned spreads and fees, excluding institutional purchase principal and tenant gross billings.
